title: Franklin Street Commercial Historic District, Bounded by 4th, Franklin, 11th, and Pine Streets, Michigan City, La Porte County, IN
notes: Significance: The Franklin Street Commercial Historic District was listed in the National Register of Historic Places (NRHP) in 2013 under Criterion A for its role in regional industry and commerce. Michigan City was an important center for regional commerce due to its location on Lake Michigan and its proximity to industrial establishments in Gary and Chicago. Following construction of the railroad through Michigan City in the 1850s, commercial activity relocated from Front Street to Franklin Street, where it remained thereafter. Franklin Street is also significant under Criterion C for its exemplary collection of commercial and residential buildings built in a variety of styles that include most prominently Italianate and Colonial Revival. The NRHP-listed period of significance for the commercial historic district is 1867-1963.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 13001013
